A_tests.assertion: true native thread ids, each OC1 read succeeds only on its issuer thread; identical numeric ns still not interchangeable

A_tests.assertion: reject forged/duplicated/misbound view; no SQL mutation
A_tests.stage_A_required_details: Each dict/copy/foreign_repo/foreign_thread attempted read/mutation is rejected by actual registry and leaves real SQL rows, lease generation and event count unchanged; publication_guard alone does not issue a view.

A_tests.assertion: real txn lifecycle invalidates capability exactly once; stored receipt not live permission
A_tests.stage_A_required_details: For each real rollback/CAS0/connection_close/commit_close/replay state, re-evaluation cannot authorize row mutation. Real connection close must invalidate even if a detached prior VALID observation exists.

A_tests.assertion: barrier holds actual guard/BEGIN; fresh read after wait, never uses pre-wait now
A_tests.stage_A_required_details: Barrier blocks the true publication guard/BEGIN; broker counter advances before lock acquired. Exact acquisition origin/deadline derive from postlock current, not prewait snapshot. A timedout/abandoned RPC cannot become ACTIVE after lock release. Do not assert acquisition must expire before it has a real origin.

A_tests.assertion: actual heartbeat thread/RPC renews unexpired segment, original task/verification/retry ids/deadlines unchanged
A_tests.stage_A_required_details: Fresh real worker+P5 owner, record original task/verification windows/policy; both main-delay-loop and real heartbeat-thread scopes can renew while current segment unexpired. Unrelated thread with same public leaseid cannot renew. Original app origins/deadlines/spend and source digests stay exact; heartbeat does not postpone a genuine original app deadline.

A_tests.assertion: actual row update refused and no new ACTIVE proposal
A_tests.stage_A_required_details: At exact D segment deadline (expired), or after real guarded cancel/reassignment, actual heartbeat SQL/CAS cannot create ACTIVE successor; ensure old worker and generic/legacy method cannot reattach. Safe release/cancel still terminates.

A_tests.assertion: no ACTIVE authority from uncommitted/ambiguous row; orphan fail closed
A_tests.stage_A_required_details: Three cases use actual SQLite rollback, actual CAS0 and actual commit with lost ack; none produces positive authority. Within confirmation_lost also deliver the stale delayed reply and prove epoch remains revoked/blocked. Retain durable phase/raw receipts instead of deleting ambiguous evidence.

A_tests.assertion: new repo/worker epoch cannot recover serialized handles or refresh same task; actual terminal/CAS history preserved
A_tests.stage_A_required_details: New repository/service lifecycle sees ended or demonstrably dead original epoch; recovery(requeue=True), manualretry and direct CAS-to-QUEUED cannot revive samejob. Old attempt terminal/history preserved, fresh public descriptor rejected. Samecase controls preserve legacy requeue policy and do not overwrite a foreign still-live process based only on registry absence.
